Diageo Appoints WPP Finance Chief Joanne Wilson as New CFO

Diageo has appointed Joanne Wilson, the finance chief of WPP, as its new Chief Financial Officer (CFO). This move is part of an overhaul of the top team by CEO Ivan Menezes. The appointment was reported by Sky News.
